translations.web: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
translations.bsb: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.
translations.kjv: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well
translations.asv: For thou shalt eat the labor of thy hands: Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
